statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tech weakness persists, but fresh post-reopen NQ price-path evidence is limited.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold; the next narrow structure checkpoints are verified Globex follow-through and Tuesday's U.S. open/data window.
headline: Tech weakness lifts stress; Tail remains watch-level
body: Monday ended with Nasdaq and semiconductor weakness, while Treasury yields and oil fell and VIX remained below 20. Fresh post-reopen NQ structure is not sufficiently verified, so Tail stays watch-level while event-week Stress remains extreme.

lookbackSummary: Tail moved from low overnight to WATCH through much of Monday's U.S. session, briefly reached elevated during the late tech-led decline, then returned to WATCH after the cash close.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours center on overnight retracement quality, Tuesday's U.S. cash open, and the 14:00 UTC Consumer Confidence/New Home Sales releases. Later-week PCE/GDP, Nvidia results and the Jackson Hole keynote keep Stress elevated.

forecast.analysis: Asian-session liquidity can magnify moves, but future directional efficiency is not assumed. Tail rises only if rebounds stay shallow and new lows extend repeatedly.
No major U.S. release is scheduled in this hour. Balanced overnight trade would favor normal conditions; persistent extension would invalidate that baseline.
A quieter overnight baseline is favored if futures remain rotational. Event-week uncertainty keeps Stress elevated even when Tail is low.
Late Asian trade is expected to remain a structure test rather than a catalyst window. Mean-reverting swings would keep Tail low.
The Asia-Europe handoff can alter liquidity. Tail would rise if European participation reinforces a one-way move with weak retracement quality.
European participation becomes more relevant. A failure to recover overnight extremes would modestly increase directional-path risk.
The Europe-U.S. handoff starts to matter for the next cash session. Persistent weakness in semiconductors and megacaps would increase Tail only if price structure also confirms.
Premarket structure becomes more informative. A gap or weak tape alone is insufficient; repeated extension after failed rebounds is the key Tail checkpoint.
U.S. premarket liquidity rises. Monday's tech weakness keeps Stress high, while lower yields and oil remain conflicting evidence against a clean one-way downside regime.

forecast.analysis: Cash-open proximity raises path risk. Tail would move higher only if semiconductors, megacaps and NQ align with shallow pullbacks or repeated downside extension.
The final pre-open hour is a narrow danger window. Opening-auction continuation with little retracement would be material Tail evidence; a fast two-way response would cap it.
The U.S. cash open is the main near-term structure test. Tail remains watch-level unless the opening move becomes persistent and retracements repeatedly fail.
Consumer Confidence and New Home Sales are scheduled at 14:00 UTC. Event importance primarily raises Stress; Tail depends on the observed post-release price path.
The first post-data hour can remain volatile. Tail would rise if the release impulse extends through failed pullbacks; orderly retracement would keep risk watch-level.
After the initial data response, the focus shifts to whether U.S. price discovery stabilizes. Cross-asset disagreement would favor mixed rather than trend conditions.
Midday conditions often reduce directional efficiency. Persistent session-extreme holding would challenge that baseline, while rotation would lower Tail.
A calmer midday baseline is favored absent renewed catalyst flow. Stress stays elevated because later-week PCE, GDP and Nvidia events remain unresolved.
The afternoon remains conditional on whether the morning impulse has fully retraced or continues to extend. Normal pullbacks would keep Tail contained.
Liquidity typically improves into the final two cash hours. A renewed directional push with weak retracements would raise Tail modestly.
Power-hour risk is elevated if NQ holds near a session extreme and semiconductors remain aligned. Otherwise, two-way closing flows favor a watch-level state.
Into the cash close, Tail depends on whether the session finishes with persistent directional efficiency or meaningful mean reversion. No outcome is assumed in advance.
After the cash close, the immediate event pressure should ease if price discovery is orderly. Nvidia and Wednesday's macro releases remain future checkpoints, not observed outcomes.
